title: Long-read scRNA-seq (PacBio Kinnex) of mus musculus: dorsal hippocampus
design_description: Barcoded full-length cDNA from 10X Genomics 3' Gene Expression v3.1 libraries of mouse dorsal hippocampus was concatenated into 16-mer arrays with the PacBio Kinnex single-cell RNA kit and sequenced on a PacBio Revio. Files are unaligned HiFi read BAMs from on-instrument CCS and Kinnex barcode demultiplexing (lima); each read is a Kinnex array and must be segmented with skera before Iso-Seq single-cell processing.
